My only question/thought is this—
(From "GA Proposal Compendium: Rules & General Advice" forum post)

"Joke/Silly Proposals: Proposals intended solely to be 'humorous' or a 'joke' are removed, however, authors may post these in the [SILLY] GA Joke Proposals Only thread."

I guess there would need to be a type of debate for that, huh? I assume the nation of Arobe would take offense to someone labeling their proposal as a joke when in reality, this is serious to them. Just a thought!
I posted that thought on the GA forum relating to the proposal, I hope I don't get eaten alive lol!!

Sometimes jokes are serious enough to pass. If GenSec and moderation let it pass it must’ve been ok, though it certainly even a resolution at vote can be nullified for rules violations if suddenly they were to agree this is just a joke
I’d say honestly a fair take since this has about the quality of a joke proposal
Thank you for your input!! You make a good point there about GenSec and moderation and it's interesting to think about!
GenSec enforces a minimum standard of "legal". In that framework, this, which is the worst GA resolution I've seen in 3 years, is not subject to removal.

Ah, I understand that now, thank you for clarifying! I'm in partnership with the proposer now and I am drafting a new one that, hopefully if agreed upon, can satisfy more nations and have some legislative "teeth" behind it instead of the current language it has. Plus a proposal name change.
I don't think a lack of teeth is the issue.
Spending one in two hundred WA dollars on drug parties is insane.
Allowing drugs to pollute every public space is insane.

Oh for sure!! Thank you for your input, it's really helpful. I plan on getting more input when it's made and agreed upon by the proposer instead of just submitting it to be reviewed by GenSec and such.
Currently I am trying to figure out, since I am still newer to NationStates, if there is a World Health department of some kind or if a proposal lays one out.
The critical issue is that we've already got GAR #657, which decriminalizes drug use and possession. There's not anything left in the at-Vote that I imagine most people would actually care to see.
Weed isn't a good thing, and its use should generally be discouraged, in much the same way that alcohol is.
I wish you luck trying to legislate in this area, but frankly I don't see it unless 657 gets repealed for something like how it allows kids to possess drugs.
Or, at least, eliminates penalties for them having drugs.

Ah, interesting! I need to look more into GAR #657 for sure. And I agree, however the proposal I’m currently writing up and working on, which would replace the absolutely ridiculous one now, would regulate the use of cannabis, promote the research and education of it, and set safeguards in place for certain common-sense issues. I’ve mentioned in the past that I have passed (irl) legislation so I do have experience crafting legislation but I also have a promise to myself that it not interfere with existing laws, so I would have to make sure this proposal wouldn’t interfere with other GA proposals like what you mentioned. I appreciate your kindness and I’m glad we’ve been discussing this!

Thanks! As to interference with existing WA legislation, that's not just a personal standard of yours but a hard requirement for all proposals. The WA doesn't do amendments, instead a resolution must be repealed if changes are to be made to its policy. If you find that you can't do what you want to do without repealing #657, a repeal-and-replace is always taken more seriously when that replacement is already being developed.
To be specific: duplication in part is allowed, but not overlap such that a new law has little to no effect. Contradiction is prohibited at any degree.
TEP votes AGAINST. Resolution defeated. (6-8-0-0)
